objective: Evaluate transfer from broader community-inspired routing, SQL, approval and CMS data without benchmark-based checkpoint selection.
dependency: Require the entire frozen v2 full-pass training, calibration, reload and 231-task JevBench run to complete and release owned processes. Never restart retired supervisors.
initialization: Final complete v2 DDP snapshot weights only; reset AdamW, rank RNG and data cursor. Bind produced snapshot hashes before starting.
new_inputs: BANKING77 and CLINC150 natural intent conversion
original approval and CMS policy controls
replay_input: Frozen community-hard-mix-v2-final train only for optimizer use; reserve its other splits
sampling: one shuffled full pass; no oversampling; at most three wrapped tail rows
focused_evaluation: Freeze an additional source-balanced new-data test/OOD panel before launch; compare v2 final and v3 final on identical inputs and preserve full denominators, errors, raw predictions and saved calibration temperatures.
external_evaluation: Once on the same231 pinned public JevBench tasks after v3 final; no hosted API repeats and no benchmark score condition on queue execution.
selection_policy: Use only predeclared final checkpoint. Do not generate data from benchmark questions, gold, or model errors. Report regressions and failed cases.
